title: Never get angry again - How to become a Calm person
description:
👉If you want to speak to me in a 1:1 coaching session over google meet,   book your slot here: https://topmate.io/helloipsita/637334 🔗

✍️I am a S.Q.A & NABET Certified Personal development coach, Tedx Speaker and a Content creator. 

I talk about human potential and help people DO life better with my 1:1 coaching sessions and online education. Explore topics like Communication, self-doubt, Soft-skills, overthinking, procrastination, confidence, and all things personal development! 

I also post on Instagram where we are a family of close to half a million people! We pride ourselves on our special SUNDAY QnA's where you can share your current problem with me or ask me a related question that I can answer through an Instagram story! 

You will walk out of this digital ecosystem feeling more relieved and with an increased sense of CLARITY as well as competence!

In Personal development coaching practice and Soft-skills training, I specialize in Perspective Reframing/Cognitive Restructuring and Performance Management respectively. 


❤️‍🩹In our community, we intensely focus on Personal accountability/responsibility. Focus on perspective reframing and work on factors you can control rather than waste time and energy on factors you can't control :) 

✅We follow a format of Mindset + Technique to solve any problem.

Read my free weekly newsletter at: https://ipsitadas.substack.com

Check out my latest course on '8 steps to overcome the Fear of Public speaking' at:
